column1: # tests/app/fixtures/play/commands.tsv -- the command each key mask must give,
# worked out by hand from examples/doom/core/src/inputport.rb (dc_in_build) and
# doomentry.rb (the fifth value, ((angleturn + 128) >> 8) & 0xff), NOT from a
# run. Row i is the mask of the message taken at tic i + 1, one row per tic in
# order, so turnheld carries from row to row. The constants: SIDEMOVE 24/40,
# FORWARDMOVE 25/50 (speed off/on), ANGLETURN 640, 1280 and 320 for the
# first IN_SLOWTURNTICS (6) tics a turn key is held; buttons ATTACK 1, USE 2,
# CHANGE 4 | weapon << 3 for the first digit key down.
